reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many downstream services including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these downstream services have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow internally.
Frontend's own p95 latency is very high at 1360.49ms, while its CPU usage is 0.007 of 0.010 cores (72% of limit), showing it is CPU throttled and likely queuing requests before processing.
No errors are reported on frontend or its downstream services, so the issue is latency due to resource exhaustion, not failures.
The frontend pod was recently recreated 331s ago due to a CPU limit change from 200m to 10m, which likely caused the CPU starvation and latency increase.
